rules.verified: Sober events: the event's own page (the host's listing) explicitly says sober, alcohol-free or recovery, or a recovery fellowship, recovery org or clubhouse runs or hosts it, or an admin confirmed it. The quote and page are stored per event.
rules.listed: Pulled automatically, not confirmed with the host.
rules.healthy: Healthy activities: daytime yoga, runs, hikes, meditation and similar whose listing mentions no alcohol. Not sober events; shown separately.
rules.social: Social-media items are never verified automatically; they wait in the admin review queue.
